text: The doctor is honest about what's good and beneficial for the patient, and tells you directly what's not good. I've been getting dental work done by this doctor since I was 25+, and now I'm over 40. I can honestly say I'll continue going to this clinic.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมบ้านปันยิ้ม
text: I went to get my teeth scaled and filled, and then the dentist said that was enough, so I paid the money. When I got home, he looked at my teeth... He ground down a notch on my teeth, didn't fill it, didn't do it again, and didn't tell me. Is this what kind of dentist is? He made me suffer so much, I endured it for so long. The tooth with the mark was so sensitive. I'm asking for this. The patient felt very bad. I won't go again. Let me tell you, this old doctor is really terrible.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมบ้านปันยิ้ม
text: First time, I had a client who was having a root canal and had to wait an hour. The staff asked if I wanted to wait. Two teeth were extracted and it took 5 minutes. Their hands were very gentle, including the anesthetic injection. I didn't feel any pain. The doctor was probably 50 years old, while the patient was 68 years old. I also returned the extracted teeth.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมบ้านปันยิ้ม
text: My appointment was at 2 PM sharp, I emphasized that. When I arrived, I had to wait for two more people ahead of me, and they wouldn't let me wait inside the shop. I understand it's for safety reasons, but this is excessive. How are people without transportation supposed to wait?

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมบ้านปันยิ้ม
text: The doctor is very kind...Thank you very much.
